task.objective: Add an inclusive, validated min_stock filter to list_products while preserving all existing catalog behavior.

def list_products(products, *, query="", include_inactive=False, min_stock=None):
    """Return matching products in input order; do not mutate caller data."""
    _validate_min_stock(min_stock)
    needle = query.casefold()
    return [
        product
        for product in products
        if (include_inactive or product.active)
        and needle in product.name.casefold()
        and (min_stock is None or product.stock >= min_stock)
    ]

import argparse
import json
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

from .service import Product, list_products

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Inventory catalog demo")
parser.add_argument("--query", default="")
parser.add_argument("--min-stock", type=int)
parser.add_argument("--include-inactive", action="store_true")
args = parser.parse_args()
data = json.loads((Path(__file__).parents[1] / "products.json").read_text())
result = list_products([Product(**item) for item in data], query=args.query,
                       min_stock=args.min_stock, include_inactive=args.include_inactive)
print(json.dumps([asdict(item) for item in result], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

Add optional min_stock to list_products. None preserves the legacy result; otherwise retain products with stock >= min_stock (inclusive). Zero is valid and there is no upper bound.
min_stock must be a non-negative built-in integer. Reject negative integers, booleans, floats, strings and containers with ValueError mentioning min_stock. Validate even for empty product input.

Preserve input order and never mutate input. Existing query is a Unicode casefold substring match. Inactive products are hidden by default; include_inactive=True reveals them. All filters compose with logical AND. Equal-stock products also retain their original relative order.

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from catalog.service import Product


@pytest.fixture
def products():
    data = json.loads((Path(__file__).parents[1] / "products.json").read_text())
    return [Product(**item) for item in data]

def test_above_all_stock(products):
    assert list_products(products, min_stock=11) == []

def test_can_include_inactive(products):
    assert [p.sku for p in list_products(products, include_inactive=True, min_stock=8)] == ["C", "D"]

def test_filters_compose(products):
    assert [p.sku for p in list_products(products, query="oCeAn", min_stock=5)] == ["C"]

def test_inclusive_threshold(products):
    assert [p.sku for p in list_products(products, min_stock=5)] == ["B", "C", "E"]

def test_large_integer_is_valid(products):
    assert list_products(products, min_stock=10**30) == []

def test_zero_keeps_zero_stock(products):
    assert [p.sku for p in list_products(products, min_stock=0)] == ["A", "B", "C", "E"]

def test_case_insensitive_search(products):
    assert [p.sku for p in list_products(products, query="oCeAn")] == ["A", "C"]

def test_default_behavior(products):
    assert [p.sku for p in list_products(products)] == ["A", "B", "C", "E"]

def test_empty_input():
    assert list_products([], min_stock=0) == []

def test_explicit_none_preserves_default(products):
    assert list_products(products, min_stock=None) == list_products(products)

def test_include_inactive(products):
    assert [p.sku for p in list_products(products, include_inactive=True)] == ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]

def test_input_not_mutated(products):
    original = list(products)
    list_products(products, query="ocean", min_stock=5)
    assert products == original

def test_new_list_returned(products):
    assert list_products(products) is not products

def test_unicode_casefold_search(products):
    assert [p.sku for p in list_products(products, query="STRASSE")] == ["E"]
